pageCoverage.coverage: L11: three objectives; six matching pictures in original order; two pair-discussion prompts.
L11 text1: context, two listen-twice choices, all seven dialogue lines, picture, numbered vocabulary1–9, 接 tip.
L11 text1: three role-reading questions. Grammar1: two full usage explanations (还是/或者), four examples, three blanks. Text2 context and two listening choices.
L11 text2: all eight dialogue lines, picture, vocabulary10–15, three role-reading questions. Grammar2 complete explanation and three examples.
L11 grammar2: three blanks. Text3: context, two listening choices, all seven dialogue lines, picture, vocabulary16–20 plus proper noun 老张.
L11 text3: three role-reading questions. Grammar3 complete explanation, three examples and three blanks. Text4 context and two listening choices.
L11 text4: complete two paragraphs, Beijing/Shanghai signpost picture, vocabulary21–27 (eight POS records), read-aloud directive and three reading questions. Grammar4 explanation and three examples.
L11 grammar4: three dialogue blanks. Two separate word banks and all ten blanks.
L11 three picture dialogues: 3+4+4 independent blanks. Complete four-person profession-guessing task and source example. No culture or review panel printed.
